fails.headline: 14 newborns die in fire at Pakistan's largest public hospital
fails.reason: headline: cited sources describe PIMS as 'Islamabad's premier/largest public hospital' (A178, A305, A543, A614) but never as 'Pakistan's largest public hospital' -- a national-superlative upgrade unsupported by any cited source, and it directly contradicts the story's own summary, which correctly calls it 'Islamabad's premier public hospital'.

fails.headline: Hungary formally classifies Russia as security threat under new PM Magyar
fails.reason: why_it_matters: the single cited source states only that Hungary classified Russia as a threat and that Magyar succeeded Orbán, who was long seen as Moscow's 'extended arm' in the EU; it does not mention NATO or describe Hungary as 'repeatedly complicating unanimous EU decisions' or as 'the most consistent dissenting voice inside both NATO and the bloc' -- these specifics are unsupported by the cited article.

fails.headline: Flash flood kills at least 17 along Nepal-Tibet border, sweeping away villages
fails.reason: why_it_matters: claims the 430MW damage means Nepal faces 'weeks of power disruption' -- no cited source states any duration for the power disruption; this is an unsupported specific.

fails.headline: Ukraine blocks virtually all Russian Black Sea grain exports; Houthis escalate Red Sea attacks
fails.reason: why_it_matters: asserts the Black Sea grain corridor 'functioned as an alternative to the Strait of Hormuz' alongside the Red Sea -- no cited source ties the Black Sea grain route to Hormuz; only Bab el-Mandeb (Red Sea) is described as a Hormuz alternative (A139). This is a fabricated relation.

fails.headline: Armenia arrests ex-president Kocharyan on corruption suspicion
fails.reason: why_it_matters: asserts Armenia has 'a recent history of mass street protests over governance' -- this specific claim about a named prior event class is not stated anywhere in the sole cited article A134.

fails.headline: Flash flood on Nepal-Tibet border kills at least 17 and sweeps away villages
fails.reason: why_it_matters: describes the Nepal-China crossing severed by the flood as 'the only major Nepal-China land crossing' -- no cited source states this crossing is the sole/only major land crossing between the two countries; this uniqueness claim is unsupported.

fails.headline: Trump sends Saudi nuclear deal to Congress, insists it hinges on Israel recognition
fails.reason: summary: claims the Israel-normalisation condition is 'not present in many prior such agreements,' but no cited source makes this comparison -- A182 discusses only that the deal's classification level (not the normalisation condition) is unusual compared to prior 123 agreements, and A31 notes even the Biden administration wanted to tie a Saudi deal to Abraham Accords normalisation, undercutting the claim that this is atypical.

fails.headline: US begins returning diplomats to Middle East posts; Rubio reportedly rules out new Iran strikes before midterms
fails.reason: headline: none of the cited articles (A217, A411, A465) state that Rubio's no-strikes assurance is tied to the midterms timeframe -- A217 only reports Rubio told foreign ministers Washington 'won't launch strikes against Iran,' with no midterms qualifier; why_it_matters: repeats the unsupported 'before the midterms' framing and adds an unsupported 'several months' duration not stated in any cited source.

fails.headline: Armenia arrests former president Kocharyan on corruption charges
fails.reason: why_it_matters: claims Kocharyan 'has long sought to return to power,' a specific characterization of his political ambitions that is not stated in the sole cited source, which only says he now leads the opposition after previously ruling the country.

fails.headline: Hungary officially designates Russia a 'threat' under new prime minister Magyar
fails.reason: why_it_matters: asserts Hungary was 'repeatedly blocking or diluting EU consensus on Ukraine sanctions and aid,' a specific claim about past events not stated in the sole cited source, which only describes Hungary generally as having been seen as Moscow's 'long arm' within the EU.

fails.headline: Hong Kong to release first five-year plan alongside annual policy address on 16 September
fails.reason: why_it_matters: claims the joint release 'aligns Hong Kong's governance framework more explicitly with mainland China's five-year planning model' and cites 'political changes already enacted under national security legislation,' but none of the cited articles (including A425, the only relevant source) mention a mainland five-year planning model comparison or national security legislation.

fails.headline: DRC Ebola outbreak is fastest-growing on record; funding shortfall and misinformation hamper response
fails.reason: why_it_matters: adds 'active conflict in eastern Congo restricting access' and 'misinformation undermining vaccination uptake' as specific mechanisms, but the sole cited source only attributes the hampered response to 'a lack of funding and widespread misinformation' generally, with no mention of conflict restricting access or vaccination uptake specifically.

fails.headline: Iran and Oman agree temporary Hormuz shipping corridor, but Tehran says strait stays closed
fails.reason: summary: claims Gharibabadi 'said Wednesday,' but cited source A19 explicitly states the remarks 'came on Tuesday,' and cited source A334 (same wire text as A26) states 'The two sides said on Tuesday they had explored creating a temporary joint shipping corridor' -- directly contradicting the Wednesday attribution.

fails.headline: Ukrainian drones destroy Wildberries warehouse in Russia, kill three across strikes
fails.reason: why_it_matters: attributes the belief that Russia's petrol-station attacks aim to 'terrorise the public into pressuring Kyiv toward an unfavourable deal' to 'Ukrainian officials,' but the cited source (A65) attributes this view only to a private citizen/driver, Kateryna Stokolya -- an unsupported attribution upgrade.

fails.headline: Nepal-Tibet flash flood kills at least eight, hundreds reported missing
fails.reason: why_it_matters: states last year's Rasuwa flood 'killed nine people,' which matches cited source A2, but directly contradicts another cited source, A50, which states 'Rasuwa saw deadly flooding last year that killed 18 people after a glacier burst.'

fails.headline: UN says 22 of 47 killed in Haiti gang attack were executed in a church
fails.reason: why_it_matters: attributes the analyst quote about gangs dispersing security resources to 'the Washington Post,' but the cited source containing that quote (A288) is published under source_id npr_world (NPR), not the Washington Post -- an unsupported/incorrect attribution.

fails.headline: Ukraine drone strikes destroy Russian warehouse as both sides hit fuel and retail targets
fails.reason: why_it_matters: claims 'Ukrainian officials say Russia's petrol-station strikes aim to deprive civilians of fuel and force capitulation,' but in cited source A65 the 'force the government to capitulate' framing is voiced only by a private driver (Kateryna Stokolya), not by any Ukrainian official -- an unsupported attribution upgrade.

fails.headline: Haiti gang leader threatens hostages as UN condemns Kenscoff 'massacre'
fails.reason: headline: quotes the UN as condemning a Kenscoff 'massacre,' but Guterres's cited statement (A7, A288) only says the attack 'underscore[s] the alarming security conditions in Haiti' -- no cited source attributes the word 'massacre' to the UN.

fails.headline: Nepal-Tibet flash flood kills at least eight, dozens missing
fails.reason: headline: no cited source states 'dozens missing' -- A2/A27/A95/A327 give no missing count for Nepal, and cited source A301's own headline instead reports 'Hundreds Missing,' directly contradicting the story's 'dozens' figure.

fails.headline: Fire in Islamabad hospital maternity ward kills 14 infants
fails.reason: summary: calls PIMS 'Pakistan's largest state hospital', but every cited source that characterizes its size scopes it to Islamabad only ('Islamabad's premier public hospital' A178, 'Islamabad's largest hospital' A305, 'one of the largest public hospitals in Islamabad' A614, 'biggest state hospital in Islamabad' A543) -- none claims it is the largest in the country.

fails.headline: Iran and Oman agree temporary shipping route through Hormuz, but Tehran keeps strait shut
fails.reason: why_it_matters: claims oil prices fell 'for a second straight day' but cited source A650 (WSJ) explicitly states prices fell 'for a third straight day' -- a direct contradiction of a cited source.
